epic.title: Fixture decomposition
epic.goal: Validate a controlled two-slice plan without dispatch.
definition_of_done: Both slices validate and final synthesis is specified

subtasks.title: Map inputs
subtasks.dispatch_prompt: Review the fixture input and report its fields.
redecompose_if: Input schema has an unresolved variant

subtasks.title: Validate synthesis
subtasks.dispatch_prompt: Validate the fixture assertions after E1.
redecompose_if: Validation needs more than one independent harness

risks: Fixture assumptions can hide runtime differences
final_verification: Run the two fixture validation commands

re_decomposition_triggers: A subtask cannot name a bounded acceptance check
